prompt: How many protons, neutrons and electrons are in the ion $^{35}_{17}\text{Cl}^{-}$?
markscheme: **D.** Protons $=Z=17$; neutrons $=35-17=18$; the 1− charge means one extra electron: 18.

prompt: Explain why isotopes of an element have the same chemical properties but different physical properties.
markscheme: Chemical properties depend on the electron arrangement, which is the same (same number of protons and electrons) **(R1)**; isotopes differ in the number of neutrons and so in mass, affecting mass-dependent properties such as density and rate of diffusion **(R1)**

concept: Relative atomic mass from a mass spectrum
prompt: The mass spectrum of magnesium shows peaks at $m/z$ 24, 25 and 26 with relative abundances 78.99%, 10.00% and 11.01%. Calculate the relative atomic mass of magnesium to two decimal places.
markscheme:
$A_r=\dfrac{24(78.99)+25(10.00)+26(11.01)}{100}$ **(M1)** $=24.32$ **(A1)**

It is a weighted mean, so it lies closest to the most abundant isotope.
